Credentials granted to you for this session (use only these):

trajectory.result: USER: Yes, that's right — please go ahead.

args.subject: Maintenance Notice
args.body:
Dear Vendor,

We are currently performing scheduled maintenance on our systems. This maintenance is expected to take approximately 2 hours and will be completed by [insert time]. During this period, you may experience brief disruptions in service.

Thank you for your understanding and continued partnership.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
